name: navigation
title: Navigation
description: Navigation callback for the page blocks.
usage: Connect a page block to your application router.
notes:
Blocks call `navigate(href)` for navigation actions. By default it loads that path. A client router can listen for
the cancelable `ds:navigate` event, call `event.preventDefault()`, then use `event.detail.href` with its own router.

reference.scope: Integration helper; no public website counterpart.

api.content:
/** Lets the host router handle a block's navigation before falling back to a normal page load. */
export declare function navigate(href: string): void;
